description: The scenes of the hover card's ground view. Read by lib/groundScene.ts (which scene fits a spot) and by footstep-generator/ground_images.py (what to paint). Edit here, then regenerate the pictures: docs/ops/ground-view.md.
template: A painted landscape illustration seen from the ground at human eye level, wide 16:9 frame. Place: {place}. Time: {time}. {detail} Show no people, no animals, no text and no buildings, except what this description names. Soft natural light, muted colours, gentle painterly brush texture, not photorealistic.

ice.place: the edge of a vast continental ice sheet, a blue-white ice wall rising behind frozen gravel flats

tundra.place: open arctic tundra: low shrubs, lichen and moss over wet ground, small pools, a long cold horizon

boreal.place: northern conifer forest and open woodland: spruce and larch, pale moss, birch at the clearings

temperate-forest.place: temperate woodland of oak, beech and pine with mossy ground and dappled light

steppe.place: wide grassland: wind-bent grasses and a few low shrubs rolling to a far horizon under a big sky

savanna.place: tropical savanna: tall dry grass, scattered flat-topped acacia-like trees, red earth, warm haze

rainforest.place: dense tropical rainforest: layered green canopy, tall trunks, hanging vines, humid mist, a slow brown river

desert.place: arid desert and dry shrubland: pale sand and stony ground, sparse thorny scrub, a hard bright sky

scrub.place: dry Mediterranean-type woodland: low evergreen oaks and aromatic shrubs on stony hills, bright dry air

glacial.time: the last Ice Age, colder and drier than today, with a thin pale light

holocene.time: the warm period after the Ice Age, before farming reached this land

farming.time: the age of early farmers, in a land they have partly cleared

herding.time: the age of herders, in open grazing land

scenes.detail: Patchy snow lies between frost-cracked ground and dwarf willow.
Cold dry grass steppe with pale earth and sparse sedge, a vast open sky.
Thin, stunted conifers with snow on the ground.
Sparse cold woodland of pine and birch with open grassy gaps.
Dry, thin tree cover and short pale grass.
Dusty, windblown dunes and bare rock under a hazy sky.
Short summer, green and brown, with flowers among the lichen.
A still lake edge, with a thin plume of smoke far off between the trees.
A clearing by a stream, a thin plume of smoke rising far off between the trunks.
Late afternoon, long shadows, a thin line of smoke on the horizon.
Shafts of light through the canopy.
A dry riverbed with a few green trees along it.
Small hand-tilled fields of grain in a forest clearing, a few low round thatched huts in the distance.
Patchwork fields of ripening grain on rolling land, a small village of low mud-brick houses far away.
Small millet fields among trees, a few round grass-roofed huts in the distance.
A wide pasture crossed by trodden paths, and a distant round felt tent with a thread of smoke. Cropped, grazed grass.
